reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Ronnie Fieg, founder and CEO of Kith.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Ronnie Fieg, founder and CEO of Kith. At age 13, Ronnie started working at David Z., an iconic New York shoe store. He worked his way up from the stockroom and earned his first collaboration in 2007, when he worked with ASICS on new Gel-Lyte 3s.

key_points.text: At age 13, Ronnie started working at David Z., an iconic New York shoe store.
That collection sold out in a day after being featured in The Wall Street Journal.
In 2011, he founded Kith, which has become one of the most influential brands in footwear, fashion, and culture.
